correctness.rationale: The exact Charlier orthogonality and Parseval isometry hold in Poisson L2 because finite support gives a square-integrable likelihood ratio. The analytic log-PGF Taylor expansion, expanding-disk Gaussian majorant, and exponentially vanishing outer tail establish strong L2 convergence of the scaled density with coefficient κ_r/(r!λ^r) times the r-th Charlier polynomial. This yields the chi-square and TV constants, and bounded entropy quadratic quotient plus uniform integrability yields one-half chi-square for KL. The truncated exponential polynomial has nonnegative normalized coefficients and the stipulated first nonzero cumulant. The standalone checker passed 1368 finite assertions; infinite validity rests on the analytic argument. Scope: fixed finite support, mean, first nonzero order and iid thinning.

value.rationale: The exact sharp rates resolve a natural gap between a published all-order KL liminf theorem and finite-support achievable upper rates. The finding classifies the information-theoretic convergence exponent by the first nonzero factorial cumulant, gives exact three-metric constants, and constructs every polynomial superconvergence order. This is not a numeric recomputation: variance-matched non-Poisson examples exhibit a qualitatively faster n^-4 rate and an unbounded hierarchy of higher cancellations.
